summary: Building an FAQ page with a search bar feature.

existing_features.title: Add a client-side search bar to the FAQ & Help Center page (frontend/src/pages/FaqHelpCenterPage.tsx) that filters the displayed FAQ items by the user’s query.
Refactor the FAQ page content into a structured in-component data model (e.g., sections -> items with question/answer strings) so filtering can be applied without duplicating markup.
Define clear empty-state behavior for the FAQ search: when no questions match the query, show an English “no results” message and provide a one-click way to clear the search.
Ensure the search UI matches the existing visual system used on the FAQ page (Card layout, typography, spacing, and existing amber accent usage).

new_feature_requests.summary: Add a search bar to the FAQ page (search/filter FAQ entries).

projectName: Add a search bar to the FAQ & Help Center page
